sentences.zh: 志二十三

translations.literal: Treatise 23
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 23

sentences.zh: 時憲四

translations.literal: Shixian 4
translations.idiomatic: Shixian Calendar 4

sentences.zh: 康熙甲子元法中

translations.literal: Within the Kangxi jiazi epoch system
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi jiazi calendrical system — middle section

sentences.zh: 日躔用數

translations.literal: Constants used for solar motion
translations.idiomatic: Constants for solar motion

sentences.zh: 康熙二十三年甲子天正冬至為法元。

translations.literal: The first month winter solstice of the jiazi year, Kangxi 23, serves as the method's epoch.
translations.idiomatic: The calendrical epoch is the winter solstice of the first month in jiazi year, Kangxi 23.

sentences.zh: 癸亥年十一月冬至。

translations.literal: Winter solstice in the eleventh month of the guihai year.
translations.idiomatic: That is the winter solstice of the eleventh month in the guihai year.

sentences.zh: 周天三百六十度。

translations.literal: The full circuit of heaven is 360 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: A full circuit of heaven comprises 360 degrees.

sentences.zh: 平分之為半周，四分之為象限，十二分之為宮，每度六十分，秒微纖以下皆以六十遞析。

translations.literal: Halve it for a half-circuit, quarter it for a quadrant, divide by twelve for mansions; each degree has sixty minutes, and seconds, microseconds, and finer units below are all subdivided by sixty in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Half the circuit gives a semicircle, a quarter gives a quadrant, and a twelfth gives a mansion; each degree contains sixty minutes, and seconds and still finer units below are all broken down by successive factors of sixty.

sentences.zh: 周天入算，化作一百二十九萬六千秒。

translations.literal: For computation the full circuit is converted into 1,296,000 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: In calculation the full circuit is expressed as 1,296,000 seconds.

sentences.zh: 周日一萬分。

translations.literal: The circuit of a day is 10,000 parts.
translations.idiomatic: The day-circle is divided into 10,000 parts.

sentences.zh: 時則二十四，刻則九十六，刻下分則一千四百四十，秒則八萬六千四百。

translations.literal: Hours number 24, quarters 96, parts under a quarter 1,440, seconds 86,400.
translations.idiomatic: There are 24 hours, 96 quarters, 1,440 fractional parts beneath a quarter, and 86,400 seconds.

sentences.zh: 周歲三百六十五日二四二一八七五。

translations.literal: The circuit of a year is 365 days 0.2421875.
translations.idiomatic: The tropical year is 365.2421875 days.

sentences.zh: 紀法六十。

translations.literal: The cycle divisor is 60.
translations.idiomatic: The sexagenary cycle divisor is 60.

sentences.zh: 宿法二十八。

translations.literal: The lodge divisor is 28.
translations.idiomatic: The lunar-mansion divisor is 28.

sentences.zh: 太陽每日平行三千五百四十八秒，小餘三三０五一六九。

translations.literal: The sun's daily mean motion is 3,548 seconds, with a fractional remainder of 0.3305169.
translations.idiomatic: The sun's mean daily motion is 3,548 seconds, fractional remainder 0.3305169.

sentences.zh: 最卑歲行六十一秒，小餘一六六六六。

translations.literal: The apogee's annual motion is 61 seconds, fractional remainder 0.16666.
translations.idiomatic: The apogee advances 61 seconds per year, fractional remainder 0.16666.

sentences.zh: 最卑日行十分秒之一又六七四六九。

translations.literal: The apogee's daily motion is one ten-thousandth of a second plus 0.67469.
translations.idiomatic: The apogee's daily motion is 0.0001 second plus 0.67469.

sentences.zh: 本天半徑一千萬。

translations.literal: The radius of the primary heaven is 10,000,000.
translations.idiomatic: The deferent radius is 10,000,000.

sentences.zh: 本輪半徑二十六萬八千八百一十二。

translations.literal: The radius of the primary epicycle is 268,812.
translations.idiomatic: The deferent epicycle radius is 268,812.

sentences.zh: 均輪半徑八萬九千六百零四。

translations.literal: The radius of the equating epicycle is 89,604.
translations.idiomatic: The equating epicycle radius is 89,604.

sentences.zh: 宿度見天文志。

translations.literal: Lodge degrees are given in the Treatise on Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: Lodge longitudes appear in the Treatise on Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 歲差五十一秒。

translations.literal: Precession is 51 seconds per year.
translations.idiomatic: Annual precession is 51 seconds.

sentences.zh: 各省及蒙古北極高度、東西偏度、見天文志。

translations.literal: The north polar altitudes and east-west offsets of each province and Mongolia are given in the Treatise on Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: North polar altitudes and longitudinal offsets for each province and Mongolia are listed in the Treatise on Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 黃赤大距，二十三度二十九分三十秒。

translations.literal: The great distance between the yellow and red paths is 23°29′30″.
translations.idiomatic: Obliquity of the ecliptic: 23°29′30″.

sentences.zh: 最卑應，七度十分十一秒十微。

translations.literal: Apogee epoch: 7°10′11″10 micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Apogee epoch: 7°10′11.10″.

sentences.zh: 氣應，七日六五六三七四九二六。

translations.literal: Qi epoch: 7 days 0.656374926.
translations.idiomatic: Solar-term epoch offset: 7.656374926 days.

sentences.zh: 宿應，五日六五六三七四九二六。

translations.literal: Lodge epoch: 5 days 0.656374926.
translations.idiomatic: Lodge epoch offset: 5.656374926 days.

sentences.zh: 日干，甲、乙、丙、丁、戊、己、庚、辛、壬、癸。

translations.literal: Day stems: jia, yi, bing, ding, wu, ji, geng, xin, ren, gui.
translations.idiomatic: The ten day-stems: jia, yi, bing, ding, wu, ji, geng, xin, ren, and gui.

sentences.zh: 支，子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉、戌、亥。

translations.literal: Branches: zi, chou, yin, mao, chen, si, wu, wei, shen, you, xu, hai.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve branches: zi, chou, yin, mao, chen, si, wu, wei, shen, you, xu, and hai.

sentences.zh: 宿名，角、亢、氐、房、心、尾、箕、斗、牛、女、虛、危、室、壁、奎、婁、胃、昂、畢、參、觜、井、鬼、柳、星、張、翼、軫。

translations.literal: Lodge names: Jiao, Kang, Di, Fang, Xin, Wei, Ji, Dou, Niu, Nü, Xu, Wei, Shi, Bi, Kui, Lou, Wei, Mao, Bi, Shen, Zi, Jing, Gui, Liu, Xing, Zhang, Yi, Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-eight lodges: Jiao, Kang, Di, Fang, Xin, Wei, Ji, Dou, Niu, Nü, Xu, Wei, Shi, Bi, Kui, Lou, Wei, Mao, Bi, Shen, Zi, Jing, Gui, Liu, Xing, Zhang, Yi, and Zhen.

sentences.zh: 時名，從十二支各分初、正。

translations.literal: Hour names: from each of the twelve branches divide into early and exact.
translations.idiomatic: Hour names: each of the twelve branches is split into early and exact halves.

sentences.zh: 起子正，盡夜子初。

translations.literal: Beginning at exact zi, ending at early night zi.
translations.idiomatic: They run from exact zi through early night zi.

sentences.zh: 推日躔法求天正冬至，置周歲，以距元年數減一得積年乘之，得中積分，加氣應得通積分，上考往古，則減氣應得通積分。

translations.literal: Method for computing solar motion — to find the first-month winter solstice: set the circuit of the year, subtract one from the number of years since the epoch and multiply to get accumulated years, multiply to get mean accumulated parts, add the qi epoch to get total accumulated parts; when projecting into antiquity, subtract the qi epoch to get total accumulated parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the winter solstice of the civil year: take the tropical year constant, multiply by the number of years elapsed since the epoch (minus one) to obtain the mean accumulated interval, then add the solar-term epoch offset for total accumulated parts; when projecting backward into antiquity, subtract the solar-term epoch instead.

sentences.zh: 其日滿紀法去之，餘為天正冬至日分。

translations.literal: When the days fill the cycle divisor, remove it; the remainder is the day-fraction of the first-month winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Remove full sexagenary cycles from the day count; the remainder is the day-fraction for the civil-year winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 上考往古，則以所餘轉與紀法相減，餘為天正冬至日分。

translations.literal: When projecting into antiquity, turn the remainder and subtract it from the cycle divisor; the remainder is the day-fraction of the first-month winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: For backward projection, subtract the remainder from the cycle divisor instead; what is left is the winter-solstice day-fraction.

sentences.zh: 自初日起甲子，其小餘以刻下分通之，如法收為時刻。

translations.literal: From the first day count jiazi; convert the fractional remainder through parts-under-quarter, and collect by rule into hours and quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Count the day-stems from jiazi on day one; convert the fractional remainder via sub-quarter parts and reduce to hours and quarters.

sentences.zh: 周日一萬分為一率，小餘為二率，刻下分為三率，求得四率為時分。

translations.literal: Take the day-circle 10,000 parts as first ratio, the fractional remainder as second ratio, parts-under-quarter as third ratio; obtain the fourth ratio as hour-fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Use the 10,000-part day-circle as the first ratio, the fractional remainder as the second, and sub-quarter parts as the third; the fourth ratio gives the hour-fraction.

sentences.zh: 滿六十分收為一時，十五分收為一刻。

translations.literal: When 60 parts are full, collect as one hour; when 15 parts are full, collect as one quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Combine every 60 parts into one hour and every 15 parts into one quarter.

sentences.zh: 初時起子正，中積分加宿應，滿宿法去之，為天正冬至值宿日分，初日起角宿。

translations.literal: Hours begin at exact zi; add the lodge epoch to the mean accumulated parts, remove when full of the lodge divisor — this is the lodge day-fraction for the first-month winter solstice; from the first day begin at the Jiao lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Hours start at exact zi; add the lodge epoch to the mean accumulated interval and remove full mansion cycles to obtain the lodge day-fraction for the winter solstice, counting mansions from Jiao on the first day.

sentences.zh: 求平行，以周日為一率，太陽每日平行為二率，天正冬至小餘與周日相減餘為三率，求得四率為年根秒數。

translations.literal: To find mean motion: take the day-circle as first ratio, the sun's daily mean motion as second ratio, the remainder of the first-month winter solstice fractional part subtracted from the day-circle as third ratio; obtain the fourth ratio as the year's-root seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For mean motion: use the day-circle as the first ratio, the sun's daily mean motion as the second, and the winter-solstice fractional remainder minus the day-circle as the third; the fourth ratio is the year's-root in seconds.

sentences.zh: 又置太陽每日平行，以本日距冬至次日數乘之，得數為秒。

translations.literal: Again set the sun's daily mean motion, multiply by the number of days from this day to the day after the winter solstice, and the number obtained is seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the sun's daily mean motion by the number of days from the current date to the day after the winter solstice to obtain seconds.

sentences.zh: 與年根相併，以宮度分收之，得平行。

translations.literal: Combine with the year's root, collect by mansion degrees and minutes, and obtain mean motion.
translations.idiomatic: Add this to the year's root and reduce to mansion, degree, and minute to obtain the mean longitude.

sentences.zh: 求實行，置最卑歲行，以積年乘之。

translations.literal: To find true motion: set the apogee's annual motion and multiply by accumulated years.
translations.idiomatic: For true motion: multiply the apogee's annual rate by the accumulated years.

sentences.zh: 又置最卑日行，以距冬至次日數乘之。

translations.literal: Again set the apogee's daily motion and multiply by the number of days from the day after the winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the apogee's daily rate by the days elapsed since the day after the winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 兩數相併，加最卑應，上考則減最卑應。

translations.literal: Combine the two numbers, add the apogee epoch; when projecting upward subtract the apogee epoch.
translations.idiomatic: Sum the two results and add the apogee epoch (subtract it when projecting backward).

sentences.zh: 以減平行為引數。

translations.literal: Subtract this from mean motion to obtain the equation argument.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from the mean longitude to obtain the equation argument.

sentences.zh: 用平三角形，以本輪半徑三分之二為對正角之邊，以引數為一角，求得對角之邊倍之。

translations.literal: Using a plane triangle, take two-thirds of the primary epicycle radius as the side opposite the right angle, take the equation argument as one angle, find the side opposite the angle and double it.
translations.idiomatic: By plane triangle: let two-thirds of the deferent epicycle radius be the side opposite the right angle, take the equation argument as one angle, and double the side opposite that angle.

sentences.zh: 又求得對又一角之邊，與本天半徑相加減。

translations.literal: Again find the side opposite the other angle and add or subtract it with the primary heaven radius.
translations.idiomatic: Find the side opposite the other angle and add or subtract it from the deferent radius.

sentences.zh: 引數三宮至八宮則相加，九宮至二宮則相減。

translations.literal: When the equation argument is in mansions 3 through 8, add; from mansion 9 through mansion 2, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If the argument falls in mansions 3–8, add; if in mansions 9–2, subtract.

sentences.zh: 復用平三角形，以加倍之數為小邊，加減本天半徑之數為大邊，正角在兩邊之中，求得對小邊之角為均數。

translations.literal: Again use a plane triangle: take the doubled number as the lesser side, the number after adding or subtracting the primary heaven radius as the greater side, the right angle between the two sides, and the angle opposite the lesser side is the equation.
translations.idiomatic: Apply another plane triangle with the doubled value as the short side and the deferent radius after addition or subtraction as the long side; the right angle lies between them, and the angle opposite the short side is the equation of center.

sentences.zh: 置平行以均數加減之，引數初宮至五宮為加，六宮至十一宮為減。

translations.literal: Set mean motion and add or subtract the equation: from the first mansion through the fifth mansion add, from the sixth through the eleventh subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the equation from the mean longitude: add for mansions 1–5, subtract for mansions 6–11.

sentences.zh: 得實行。

translations.literal: Obtain true motion.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the true longitude.

sentences.zh: 求宿度，以積年乘歲差，得數加甲子法元黃道宿度，為本年宿鈐，以減實行，餘為日躔宿度。

translations.literal: To find lodge degree: multiply accumulated years by annual precession, add the number to the jiazi epoch ecliptic lodge degree to get this year's lodge pivot, subtract from true motion; the remainder is the solar-motion lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: For lodge longitude: multiply years elapsed by annual precession, add to the jiazi-epoch ecliptic lodge position to obtain this year's lodge pivot, subtract from the true longitude; the remainder is the sun's lodge position.

sentences.zh: 若實行不及減宿鈐，退一宿減之。

translations.literal: If true motion is insufficient to subtract the lodge pivot, retreat one lodge and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If the true longitude is less than the lodge pivot, step back one lodge before subtracting.

sentences.zh: 求紀日值宿，置距冬至次日數，加冬至，日滿紀法去之。

translations.literal: To find the cycle-day lodge position: set the number of days from the day after the winter solstice, add the winter solstice, remove when days fill the cycle divisor.
translations.idiomatic: For the sexagenary day and its lodge: take days since the day after the winter solstice, add the solstice day-count, and remove full cycles of 60.

sentences.zh: 初日起甲子，加冬至值宿，日滿宿法去之。

translations.literal: From the first day begin jiazi, add the winter solstice lodge position, remove when days fill the lodge divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Count day-stems from jiazi on day one, add the solstice lodge, and remove full cycles of 28 mansions.

sentences.zh: 初日起角宿，得紀日值宿。

translations.literal: From the first day begin at the Jiao lodge; obtain the cycle-day lodge position.
translations.idiomatic: Starting mansions from Jiao on day one gives the cycle-day and its lodge.

sentences.zh: 求節氣時刻，日躔初宮丑，星紀。

translations.literal: To find solar-term moments: solar motion in the first mansion is Chou, Xingji.
translations.idiomatic: To find solar-term times: the sun's first mansion is Chou (Xingji).

sentences.zh: 初度為冬至，十五度為小寒。

translations.literal: The initial degree is winter solstice, the fifteenth degree is Lesser Cold.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is the winter solstice; degree 15 is Lesser Cold.

sentences.zh: 一宮子，元枵。

translations.literal: The first mansion is Zi, Yuanxiao.
translations.idiomatic: Mansion 1 is Zi (Yuanxiao).

sentences.zh: 初度為大寒，十五度為立春。

translations.literal: The initial degree is Greater Cold, the fifteenth degree is Beginning of Spring.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is Greater Cold; degree 15 is Beginning of Spring.

sentences.zh: 二宮亥，娵訾。

translations.literal: The second mansion is Hai, Zouzi.
translations.idiomatic: Mansion 2 is Hai (Zouzi).

sentences.zh: 初度為雨水，十五度為驚蟄。

translations.literal: The initial degree is Rain Water, the fifteenth degree is Awakening of Insects.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is Rain Water; degree 15 is Awakening of Insects.

sentences.zh: 三宮戌，降婁。

translations.literal: The third mansion is Xu, Jianglou.
translations.idiomatic: Mansion 3 is Xu (Jianglou).

sentences.zh: 初度為春分，十五度為清明。

translations.literal: The initial degree is spring equinox, the fifteenth degree is Clear and Bright.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is the spring equinox; degree 15 is Clear and Bright.

sentences.zh: 四宮酉，大梁。

translations.literal: The fourth mansion is You, Daliang.
translations.idiomatic: Mansion 4 is You (Daliang).

sentences.zh: 初度為穀雨，十五度為立夏。

translations.literal: The initial degree is Grain Rain, the fifteenth degree is Beginning of Summer.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is Grain Rain; degree 15 is Beginning of Summer.

sentences.zh: 五宮申，實沈。

translations.literal: The fifth mansion is Shen, Shichen.
translations.idiomatic: Mansion 5 is Shen (Shichen).

sentences.zh: 初度為小滿，十五度為芒種。

translations.literal: The initial degree is Lesser Fullness, the fifteenth degree is Grain in Ear.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is Lesser Fullness; degree 15 is Grain in Ear.

sentences.zh: 六宮未，鶉首。

translations.literal: The sixth mansion is Wei, Chunshou.
translations.idiomatic: Mansion 6 is Wei (Chunshou).

sentences.zh: 初度為夏至，十五度為小暑。

translations.literal: The initial degree is summer solstice, the fifteenth degree is Lesser Heat.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is the summer solstice; degree 15 is Lesser Heat.

sentences.zh: 七宮午，鶉火。

translations.literal: The seventh mansion is Wu, Chunhuo.
translations.idiomatic: Mansion 7 is Wu (Chunhuo).

sentences.zh: 初度為大暑，十五度為立秋。

translations.literal: The initial degree is Greater Heat, the fifteenth degree is Beginning of Autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is Greater Heat; degree 15 is Beginning of Autumn.

sentences.zh: 八宮巳，鶉尾。

translations.literal: The eighth mansion is Si, Chunwei.
translations.idiomatic: Mansion 8 is Si (Chunwei).

sentences.zh: 初度為處暑，十五度為白露。

translations.literal: The initial degree is End of Heat, the fifteenth degree is White Dew.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is End of Heat; degree 15 is White Dew.

sentences.zh: 九宮辰，壽星。

translations.literal: The ninth mansion is Chen, Shouxing.
translations.idiomatic: Mansion 9 is Chen (Shouxing).

sentences.zh: 初度為秋分，十五度為寒露。

translations.literal: The initial degree is autumn equinox, the fifteenth degree is Cold Dew.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is the autumn equinox; degree 15 is Cold Dew.

sentences.zh: 十宮卯，大火。

translations.literal: The tenth mansion is Mao, Dahu.
translations.idiomatic: Mansion 10 is Mao (Dahu).

sentences.zh: 初度為霜降，十五度為立冬。

translations.literal: The initial degree is Frost's Descent, the fifteenth degree is Beginning of Winter.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is Frost's Descent; degree 15 is Beginning of Winter.

sentences.zh: 十一宮寅，析木。

translations.literal: The eleventh mansion is Yin, Ximu.
translations.idiomatic: Mansion 11 is Yin (Ximu).

sentences.zh: 初度為小雪，十五度為大雪。

translations.literal: The initial degree is Lesser Snow, the fifteenth degree is Greater Snow.
translations.idiomatic: Degree 0 is Lesser Snow; degree 15 is Greater Snow.

sentences.zh: 皆以子正日躔未交節氣宮度者，為交節氣本日；

translations.literal: All take exact zi: when solar motion has not yet reached the solar-term mansion degree, that is the day the term is entered;
translations.idiomatic: At exact zi, if the sun has not yet reached the term's mansion degree, that day is the term-entry day;

sentences.zh: 已過節氣宮度者，為交節氣次日。

translations.literal: when it has already passed the solar-term mansion degree, that is the day after term entry.
translations.idiomatic: if it has already passed that degree, term entry falls on the following day.

sentences.zh: 乃以本日實行與次日實行相減為一率，每日刻下分為二率，本日子正實行與節氣宮度相減為三率，求得四率為距子正後之分數，乃以時刻收之，即得節氣初正時刻。

translations.literal: Then subtract this day's true motion from the next day's true motion as first ratio, daily parts-under-quarter as second ratio, subtract this day's exact-zi true motion from the solar-term mansion degree as third ratio; obtain the fourth ratio as the fraction after exact zi, then collect into hours and quarters — thus obtain the early and exact moments of the solar term.
translations.idiomatic: Take the difference between today's and tomorrow's true longitudes as the first ratio, the daily sub-quarter parts as the second, and the gap between today's exact-zi true longitude and the term's mansion degree as the third; the fourth ratio is the interval after exact zi, which reduces to hours and quarters to give the term's early and exact times.

sentences.zh: 如實行適與節氣宮度相符而無餘分，即為子正初刻。

translations.literal: If true motion exactly matches the solar-term mansion degree with no remainder, that is exact zi, first quarter.
translations.idiomatic: If the true longitude exactly matches the term's mansion degree with no remainder, the term falls at exact zi in the first quarter.

sentences.zh: 求各省節氣時刻，皆以京師為主，視偏度加減之。

translations.literal: To find each province's solar-term moments, all take the capital as standard and add or subtract according to offset degree.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial solar-term times are adjusted from the capital according to each place's longitudinal offset.

sentences.zh: 每偏一度，加減時之四分。

translations.literal: For each degree of offset, add or subtract one quarter of an hour.
translations.idiomatic: Each degree of offset shifts the time by one quarter-hour.

sentences.zh: 偏東則加，偏西則減。

translations.literal: Offset east then add, offset west then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add for places east of the capital, subtract for places west.

sentences.zh: 推節氣用時法，以交節氣本日均數變時為均數時差，反其加減。

translations.literal: Method for deriving solar-term apparent time: convert the equation on the term-entry day into time as the equation time difference, and reverse its addition or subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: For apparent solar-term time: convert the term-entry day's equation into a time correction and apply it with reversed sign.

sentences.zh: 又以半徑為一率，黃赤大距餘弦為二率，本節氣黃道度正切為三率，求得四率為赤道正切。

translations.literal: Again take radius as first ratio, cosine of the great yellow-red distance as second ratio, tangent of this solar term's ecliptic degree as third ratio; obtain the fourth ratio as equatorial tangent.
translations.idiomatic: Next use the radius as the first ratio, the cosine of obliquity as the second, and the tangent of the term's ecliptic longitude as the third; the fourth ratio is the equatorial tangent.

sentences.zh: 檢表得度，與黃道相減，餘變時為升度時差。

translations.literal: Look up the table to obtain degrees, subtract from the ecliptic, convert the remainder into time as the ascension time difference.
translations.idiomatic: Look up the degree in the table, subtract from the ecliptic longitude, and convert the difference to the ascension time correction.

sentences.zh: 二分後為加，二至後為減。

translations.literal: After the two equinoxes add, after the two solstices subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add after the equinoxes, subtract after the solstices.

sentences.zh: 皆加減節氣時刻，為節氣用時。

translations.literal: All add or subtract from the solar-term moment to obtain apparent solar-term time.
translations.idiomatic: Apply both corrections to the mean term time to obtain apparent time.

sentences.zh: 求距緯度，以本天半徑為一率，黃赤大距度之正弦為二率，實行距春秋分前後度之正弦為三率，實行初宮初度至二宮末度，與三宮相減，餘為春分前；

translations.literal: To find distance in latitude: take primary heaven radius as first ratio, sine of the great yellow-red distance in degrees as second ratio, sine of true motion's degrees before and after the spring and autumn equinoxes as third ratio; from true motion's first degree of the first mansion to the end of the second mansion, subtract the third mansion — the remainder is before spring equinox;
translations.idiomatic: For ecliptic latitude: use the deferent radius as the first ratio, the sine of obliquity as the second, and the sine of the sun's distance from the equinoxes as the third; from mansion 1 degree 0 through the end of mansion 2, subtract mansion 3 — the remainder is before the spring equinox;

sentences.zh: 三宮初度至五宮末度，則減去三宮，為春分後。

translations.literal: From the third mansion's initial degree to the end of the fifth mansion, then subtract the third mansion — that is after spring equinox.
translations.idiomatic: From mansion 3 degree 0 through the end of mansion 5, subtract mansion 3 for the interval after the spring equinox.

sentences.zh: 六宮初度至八宮末度，與九宮相減，餘為秋分前；

translations.literal: From the sixth mansion's initial degree to the end of the eighth mansion, subtract the ninth mansion — the remainder is before autumn equinox;
translations.idiomatic: From mansion 6 degree 0 through the end of mansion 8, subtract mansion 9 for before the autumn equinox;

sentences.zh: 九宮初度至十一宮末度，則減去九宮，為秋分後。

translations.literal: From the ninth mansion's initial degree to the end of the eleventh mansion, subtract the ninth mansion — that is after autumn equinox.
translations.idiomatic: From mansion 9 degree 0 through the end of mansion 11, subtract mansion 9 for after the autumn equinox.

sentences.zh: 求得四率為正弦，檢表得距緯度。

translations.literal: Obtain the fourth ratio as sine, look up the table to get distance in latitude.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth ratio is a sine; look it up in the table to obtain the latitude.

sentences.zh: 實行三宮至八宮，其緯在赤道北；

translations.literal: When true motion is in mansions 3 through 8, its latitude is north of the equator;
translations.idiomatic: For true motion in mansions 3–8, latitude is north of the equator;

sentences.zh: 九宮至二宮，其緯在赤道南。

translations.literal: from mansion 9 through mansion 2, its latitude is south of the equator.
translations.idiomatic: for mansions 9–2, latitude is south of the equator.

sentences.zh: 求日出入晝夜時刻，以本天半徑為一率，北極高度之正切為二率，本日距緯度之正切為三率，求得四率為正弦，檢表得日出入在卯酉前後赤道度。

translations.literal: To find sunrise, sunset, and day-night moments: take primary heaven radius as first ratio, tangent of north polar altitude as second ratio, tangent of this day's distance in latitude as third ratio; obtain the fourth ratio as sine, look up the table to get the equatorial degrees before and after Mao and You for sunrise and sunset.
translations.idiomatic: For sunrise, sunset, and day-night length: use the deferent radius as the first ratio, the tangent of north polar altitude as the second, and the tangent of the day's ecliptic latitude as the third; the fourth ratio is a sine looked up in the table as the equatorial arc from Mao or You at rising and setting.

sentences.zh: 變時，一度變時之四分，凡言變時皆仿此。

translations.literal: Convert to time: one degree converts to one quarter of an hour; wherever conversion to time is mentioned, follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Convert degrees to time at one quarter-hour per degree; all time conversions follow this rule.

sentences.zh: 為距卯酉分。

translations.literal: This is the fraction from Mao and You.
translations.idiomatic: This gives the interval from Mao or You.

sentences.zh: 以加減卯酉時，即得日出入時刻。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from the Mao-You hours to obtain sunrise and sunset moments.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract from the Mao and You times to obtain sunrise and sunset.

sentences.zh: 春分前、秋分後，以加卯正為日出，減酉正為日入。

translations.literal: Before spring equinox and after autumn equinox, add for exact Mao as sunrise, subtract from exact You as sunset.
translations.idiomatic: Before the spring equinox and after the autumn equinox, add to exact Mao for sunrise and subtract from exact You for sunset.

sentences.zh: 春分後、秋分前，以減卯正為日出，加酉正為日入。

translations.literal: After spring equinox and before autumn equinox, subtract from exact Mao as sunrise, add to exact You as sunset.
translations.idiomatic: After the spring equinox and before the autumn equinox, subtract from exact Mao for sunrise and add to exact You for sunset.

sentences.zh: 又倍距卯酉分，以加減半晝分，得晝夜時刻。

translations.literal: Again double the fraction from Mao and You, add or subtract from the half-daylight fraction, and obtain day and night moments.
translations.idiomatic: Double the Mao-You interval and add or subtract it from the half-daylight value to obtain day and night lengths.

sentences.zh: 春分後以加得晝刻，以減得夜刻，秋分後反是。

translations.literal: After spring equinox add to obtain daylight quarters, subtract to obtain night quarters; after autumn equinox the reverse.
translations.idiomatic: After the spring equinox, add to get daylight quarters and subtract for night quarters; after the autumn equinox, reverse the operations.

sentences.zh: 月離用數

translations.literal: Constants used for lunar motion
translations.idiomatic: Constants for lunar motion

sentences.zh: 太陰每日平行四萬七千四百三十五秒，小餘０二一一七七。

translations.literal: The moon's daily mean motion is 47,435 seconds, fractional remainder 0.021177.
translations.idiomatic: The moon's mean daily motion is 47,435 seconds, fractional remainder 0.021177.

sentences.zh: 太陰每時四刻。

translations.literal: The moon each hour is four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: The moon advances four quarters per hour.

sentences.zh: 平行一千九百七十六秒，小餘四五九二一五七。

translations.literal: Mean motion 1,976 seconds, fractional remainder 0.4592157.
translations.idiomatic: Hourly mean motion is 1,976 seconds, fractional remainder 0.4592157.

sentences.zh: 月孛即最高，每日行四百０一秒，小餘０七七四七七。

translations.literal: Lunar apogee, that is the highest point, moves 401 seconds daily, fractional remainder 0.077477.
translations.idiomatic: The lunar apogee moves 401 seconds per day, fractional remainder 0.077477.

sentences.zh: 正交每日平行一百九十秒，小餘六四。

translations.literal: The node daily mean motion is 190 seconds, fractional remainder 0.64.
translations.idiomatic: The ascending node moves 190 seconds per day, fractional remainder 0.64.

sentences.zh: 本輪半徑五十八萬。

translations.literal: Primary epicycle radius 580,000.
translations.idiomatic: Deferent epicycle radius: 580,000.

sentences.zh: 均輪半徑二十九萬。

translations.literal: Equating epicycle radius 290,000.
translations.idiomatic: Equating epicycle radius: 290,000.

sentences.zh: 負圈半徑七十九萬七千。

translations.literal: Negative circle radius 797,000.
translations.idiomatic: Auxiliary circle radius: 797,000.

sentences.zh: 次輪半徑二十一萬七千。

translations.literal: Secondary epicycle radius 217,000.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary epicycle radius: 217,000.

sentences.zh: 次均輪半徑一十一萬七千五百。

translations.literal: Secondary equating epicycle radius 117,500.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary equating epicycle radius: 117,500.

sentences.zh: 朔、望黃白大距四度五十八分三十秒。

translations.literal: At new and full moon the great yellow-white distance is 4°58′30″.
translations.idiomatic: Ecliptic-lunar latitude at syzygy: 4°58′30″.

sentences.zh: 兩弦黃白大距五度一十七分三十秒。

translations.literal: At the two quadratures the great yellow-white distance is 5°17′30″.
translations.idiomatic: Ecliptic-lunar latitude at quadrature: 5°17′30″.

sentences.zh: 黃白大距中數五度０八分。

translations.literal: The mean number of the great yellow-white distance is 5°08′.
translations.idiomatic: Mean ecliptic-lunar latitude: 5°08′.

sentences.zh: 黃白大距半較九分三十秒。

translations.literal: Half-difference of the great yellow-white distance is 9′30″.
translations.idiomatic: Half-variation of ecliptic-lunar latitude: 9′30″.

sentences.zh: 太陰平行應一宮０八度四十分五十七秒十六微。

translations.literal: Moon mean-motion epoch: mansion 1, 8°40′57″16 micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar mean-motion epoch: 1 mansion 8°40′57.16″.

sentences.zh: 月孛應三宮０四度四十九分五十四秒０九微。

translations.literal: Lunar apogee epoch: mansion 3, 4°49′54″09 micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar apogee epoch: 3 mansions 4°49′54.09″.

sentences.zh: 正交應六宮二十七度十三分三十七秒四十八微。

translations.literal: Node epoch: mansion 6, 27°13′37″48 micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Node epoch: 6 mansions 27°13′37.48″.

sentences.zh: 推月離法求天正冬至，同日躔。

translations.literal: Method for computing lunar motion — to find the first-month winter solstice, same as solar motion.
translations.idiomatic: To find the civil-year winter solstice for lunar motion, use the same method as for solar motion.

sentences.zh: 求太陰平行，置中積分，加氣應詳日躔。

translations.literal: To find the moon's mean motion: set the mean accumulated parts, add the qi epoch — see solar motion for details.
translations.idiomatic: For lunar mean motion: take the mean accumulated interval and add the solar-term epoch offset, as described under solar motion.

sentences.zh: 小餘，不用日，下同。

translations.literal: Fractional remainder, do not use days — same below.
translations.idiomatic: Use only the fractional remainder, not the day count; the same applies below.

sentences.zh: 減天正冬至小餘，得積日。

translations.literal: Subtract the first-month winter solstice fractional remainder to obtain accumulated days.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the winter-solstice fractional remainder to obtain accumulated days.

sentences.zh: 上考則減氣應小餘，加天正冬至小餘。

translations.literal: When projecting upward subtract the qi epoch fractional remainder, add the first-month winter solstice fractional remainder.
translations.idiomatic: When projecting backward, subtract the solar-term fractional remainder and add the winter-solstice fractional remainder.

sentences.zh: 與太陰每日平行相乘，滿周天秒數去之，餘數收為宮度分。

translations.literal: Multiply by the moon's daily mean motion, remove when full of the full-circuit seconds, collect the remainder as mansion degrees and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the moon's daily mean motion, remove full circuits of heaven in seconds, and reduce the remainder to mansions, degrees, and minutes.

sentences.zh: 以加太陰平行應，得太陰年根。

translations.literal: Add to the moon mean-motion epoch to obtain the moon's year's root.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the lunar mean-motion epoch to obtain the year's root.

sentences.zh: 上考則減，又置太陰每日平行，以距天正冬至次日數乘之，得數為秒。

translations.literal: When projecting upward subtract; again set the moon's daily mean motion, multiply by days from the day after the first-month winter solstice, the number obtained is seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract when projecting backward; multiply the moon's daily mean motion by days since the day after the winter solstice to obtain seconds.

sentences.zh: 以宮度分收之，與年根相併，滿十二宮去之。

translations.literal: Collect by mansion degrees and minutes, combine with the year's root, remove when full of twelve mansions.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce to mansions, degrees, and minutes, add to the year's root, and remove full cycles of twelve mansions.

sentences.zh: 為太陰平行。

translations.literal: This is the moon's mean motion.
translations.idiomatic: This is the lunar mean longitude.

sentences.zh: 求月孛行，以積日見前條，下同。

translations.literal: To find lunar apogee motion, use accumulated days as in the previous section — same below.
translations.idiomatic: For lunar apogee motion, use accumulated days as above; the same applies below.

sentences.zh: 與月孛每日行相乘，滿周天秒數去之，餘數收為宮度分。

translations.literal: Multiply by the lunar apogee's daily motion, remove when full of full-circuit seconds, collect remainder as mansion degrees and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the apogee's daily rate, remove full circuits in seconds, and reduce the remainder to mansions, degrees, and minutes.

sentences.zh: 以加月孛應，得月孛年根。

translations.literal: Add to the lunar apogee epoch to obtain the lunar apogee year's root.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the apogee epoch to obtain the apogee year's root.

sentences.zh: 上考則減。

translations.literal: When projecting upward subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract when projecting backward.

sentences.zh: 又置月孛每日行以距天正冬至次日數乘之，得數為秒，以宮度分收之，與年根相併，滿十二宮去之。

translations.literal: Again set the lunar apogee daily motion and multiply by days from the day after the first-month winter solstice, obtain seconds, collect as mansion degrees and minutes, combine with year's root, remove when full of twelve mansions.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the apogee's daily rate by days since the day after the winter solstice, reduce to mansions, degrees, and minutes, add to the year's root, and remove full twelve-mansion cycles.

sentences.zh: 為月孛行。

translations.literal: This is lunar apogee motion.
translations.idiomatic: This is the lunar apogee longitude.

sentences.zh: 求正交平行，以積日與正交每日平行相乘，滿周天秒數去之，餘數收為宮度分，以減正交應，正交應不足減者，加十二宮減之。

translations.literal: To find node mean motion: multiply accumulated days by the node's daily mean motion, remove when full of full-circuit seconds, collect as mansion degrees and minutes, subtract from the node epoch; if the node epoch is insufficient to subtract, add twelve mansions and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: For the node's mean motion: multiply accumulated days by the node's daily rate, reduce to mansions, degrees, and minutes, and subtract from the node epoch; if the epoch is too small, add twelve mansions before subtracting.

sentences.zh: 得正交年根。

translations.literal: Obtain the node's year's root.
translations.idiomatic: This gives the node's year's root.

sentences.zh: 上考則加。

translations.literal: When projecting upward add.
translations.idiomatic: Add when projecting backward.

sentences.zh: 又置正交每日平行，以距天正冬至次日數乘之，得數為秒，以宮度分收之，以減年根，年根不足減者，加十二宮減之。

translations.literal: Again set the node's daily mean motion, multiply by days from the day after the first-month winter solstice, obtain seconds, collect as mansion degrees and minutes, subtract from the year's root; if the year's root is insufficient, add twelve mansions and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the node's daily rate by days since the day after the winter solstice, reduce to mansions, degrees, and minutes, and subtract from the year's root; if needed, add twelve mansions before subtracting.

sentences.zh: 為正交平行。

translations.literal: This is node mean motion.
translations.idiomatic: This is the node's mean longitude.

sentences.zh: 求用時太陰平行，以本日太陽均數變時，詳日躔。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time moon mean motion: convert this day's solar equation to time — see solar motion for details.
translations.idiomatic: For the moon's mean longitude at apparent time: convert the sun's equation to a time correction, as under solar motion.

sentences.zh: 得均數時差。

translations.literal: Obtain the equation time difference.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the equation time correction.

sentences.zh: 均數加者，時差為減；

translations.literal: When the equation adds, the time difference subtracts;
translations.idiomatic: If the equation is added, the time correction is subtracted;

sentences.zh: 均數減者，時差為加。

translations.literal: when the equation subtracts, the time difference adds.
translations.idiomatic: if the equation is subtracted, the time correction is added.

sentences.zh: 又以本日太陽黃、赤經度詳日躔。

translations.literal: Again take this day's solar yellow and red longitudes — see solar motion for details.
translations.idiomatic: Also obtain the sun's ecliptic and equatorial longitudes for the day, as under solar motion.

sentences.zh: 相減餘數變時，得升度時差。

translations.literal: Subtract the remainder and convert to time to obtain the ascension time difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract them and convert the difference to the ascension time correction.

sentences.zh: 二分後為加，二至後為減。

translations.literal: After the two equinoxes add, after the two solstices subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add after the equinoxes, subtract after the solstices.

sentences.zh: 乃以兩時差相加減，為時差總。

translations.literal: Then add or subtract the two time differences as the total time difference.
translations.idiomatic: Combine the two time corrections to obtain the total time difference.

sentences.zh: 兩時差加減同號者，則相加為總，加者仍為加，減者仍為減。

translations.literal: When the two time differences have the same sign of addition or subtraction, add them for the total; what adds still adds, what subtracts still subtracts.
translations.idiomatic: If both corrections share the same sign, add them; addition stays addition and subtraction stays subtraction.

sentences.zh: 加減異號者，則相減為總，加數大者為加，減數大者為減。

translations.literal: When the signs differ, subtract for the total; whichever of addition or subtraction is larger determines the sign.
translations.idiomatic: If the signs differ, subtract the smaller from the larger and take the sign of the larger value.

sentences.zh: 化秒，與太陰每時平行相乘為實，以一度化秒為法除之，得數為秒，以度分收之，得時差行。

translations.literal: Convert to seconds, multiply by the moon's hourly mean motion as dividend, divide by one degree converted to seconds as divisor, obtain seconds, collect as degrees and minutes, obtain time-difference motion.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the total to seconds, multiply by the moon's hourly mean motion, divide by the seconds in one degree, and reduce the result to degrees and minutes as the time-difference displacement.

sentences.zh: 以加減太陰平行，時差總為加者則減，減者則加。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from the moon's mean motion: when the total time difference adds, subtract; when it subtracts, add.
translations.idiomatic: Apply it to lunar mean motion with reversed sign: subtract if the total correction adds, add if it subtracts.

sentences.zh: 為用時太陰平行。

translations.literal: This is apparent-time moon mean motion.
translations.idiomatic: This is the lunar mean longitude at apparent time.

sentences.zh: 求初實行，置用時太陰平行，減去月孛行，得引數。

translations.literal: To find the first true motion: set apparent-time moon mean motion, subtract lunar apogee motion, obtain the equation argument.
translations.idiomatic: For the first true longitude: subtract the apogee longitude from the apparent-time mean longitude to obtain the equation argument.

sentences.zh: 用平三角形，以本輪半徑之半為對正角之邊，以引數為一角，求得對角之邊三因之。

translations.literal: Using a plane triangle, take half the primary epicycle radius as the side opposite the right angle, take the equation argument as one angle, find the side opposite the angle and treble it.
translations.idiomatic: By plane triangle: use half the deferent epicycle radius as the side opposite the right angle, take the equation argument as one angle, and triple the opposite side.

sentences.zh: 又求得對又一角之邊，與本天半徑相加減。

translations.literal: Again find the side opposite the other angle and add or subtract with the primary heaven radius.
translations.idiomatic: Find the side opposite the other angle and add or subtract it from the deferent radius.

sentences.zh: 引數九宮至二宮相加，三宮至八宮相減。

translations.literal: When the equation argument is in mansions 9 through 2, add; in mansions 3 through 8, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add for argument mansions 9–2, subtract for mansions 3–8.

sentences.zh: 復用平三角形，以三因數為小邊，加減本天半徑數為大邊，正角在兩邊之中，求得對小邊之角為初均數，★求得對正角之邊。

translations.literal: Again use a plane triangle: take the trebled number as the lesser side, the number after adding or subtracting the primary heaven radius as the greater side, the right angle between the two sides, obtain the angle opposite the lesser side as the first equation; also obtain the side opposite the right angle.
translations.idiomatic: Apply another plane triangle with the tripled value as the short side and the adjusted deferent radius as the long side; the angle opposite the short side is the first equation, and the side opposite the right angle is also found.

sentences.zh: 即次輪最近點距地心之線。

translations.literal: This is the line from the secondary epicycle's nearest point to Earth's center.
translations.idiomatic: This is the line from Earth's center to the secondary epicycle's nearest point.

sentences.zh: 乃置用時太陰平行，以初均數加減之，引數初宮至五宮為減，六宮以後為加。

translations.literal: Then set apparent-time moon mean motion and add or subtract the first equation: from the first mansion through the fifth subtract, from the sixth onward add.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the first equation from the apparent-time mean longitude: subtract for mansions 1–5, add from mansion 6 onward.

sentences.zh: 為初實行。

translations.literal: This is the first true motion.
translations.idiomatic: This is the first true longitude.

sentences.zh: 求白道實行，置初實行，減本日太陽實行得次引。

translations.literal: To find the white-path true motion: set the first true motion, subtract this day's solar true motion to obtain the secondary argument.
translations.idiomatic: For true lunar latitude motion: subtract the sun's true longitude from the first true longitude to obtain the secondary argument.

sentences.zh: 即距日度。

translations.literal: This is the degree of distance from the sun.
translations.idiomatic: This is the elongation from the sun.

sentences.zh: 用平三角形，以次輪最近點距地心線為一邊，倍次引之通弦本天半徑為一率，次引之正弦為二率，次輪半徑為三率，求得四率倍之即通弦。

translations.literal: Using a plane triangle, take the line from the secondary epicycle nearest point to Earth's center as one side; double the secondary argument's versed sine with primary heaven radius as first ratio, sine of secondary argument as second ratio, secondary epicycle radius as third ratio; obtain the fourth ratio doubled as the versed sine.
translations.idiomatic: By plane triangle: one side is the line to the secondary epicycle's nearest point; use double the secondary argument's versed sine with deferent radius as the first ratio, the sine of the secondary argument as the second, and the secondary epicycle radius as the third; double the fourth ratio to obtain the chord.

sentences.zh: 為一邊；

translations.literal: As one side;
translations.idiomatic: As one side;

sentences.zh: 以初均數與引數減半周之度引數不及半周，則與半周相減，如過半周，則減去半周。

translations.literal: Add the first equation to the argument minus a semicircle; if the argument does not reach a semicircle, subtract it from a semicircle; if it passes a semicircle, subtract a semicircle.
translations.idiomatic: Combine the first equation with the argument reduced by a semicircle: if the argument is less than 180°, subtract it from 180°; if greater, subtract 180°.

sentences.zh: 相加，又以次引距象限度次引不及象限，則與象限相減；

translations.literal: Add together, and again take the secondary argument's distance from the quadrant limit; if the secondary argument does not reach a quadrant, subtract it from a quadrant;
translations.idiomatic: Add these, then take the secondary argument's distance from a quadrant: if less than 90°, subtract from 90°;

sentences.zh: 如過象限及過三象限，則減去象限及三象限，用其餘；

translations.literal: if it passes a quadrant and passes three quadrants, subtract a quadrant and three quadrants and use the remainder;
translations.idiomatic: if beyond 90° or 270°, subtract 90° or 270° and use the remainder;

sentences.zh: 如過二象限，則減去二象限，餘數仍與象限相減，為次引距象限度。

translations.literal: if it passes two quadrants, subtract two quadrants, the remainder still subtracted from a quadrant — this is the secondary argument's distance from the quadrant limit.
translations.idiomatic: if beyond 180°, subtract 180° and again subtract from 90° to obtain the secondary argument's quadrant distance.

sentences.zh: 加減之，初均數減者，次引過象限或過三象限則相加，不過象限或過二象限則相減。

translations.literal: Add or subtract: when the first equation subtracts, if the secondary argument passes a quadrant or three quadrants then add, if it does not pass a quadrant or passes two quadrants then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Combine them: if the first equation subtracts, add when the secondary argument exceeds 90° or 270°, subtract otherwise.

sentences.zh: 初均數加者反是。

translations.literal: When the first equation adds, the reverse.
translations.idiomatic: Reverse the rule when the first equation adds.

sentences.zh: 為所夾之角，若相加過半周，則與全周相減，用其餘為所夾之角。

translations.literal: As the contained angle; if the sum passes a semicircle, subtract from the full circuit and use the remainder as the contained angle.
translations.idiomatic: This is the included angle; if the sum exceeds 180°, subtract from 360°.

sentences.zh: 若相加適足半周或相減無餘，則無二均數。

translations.literal: If the sum exactly fills a semicircle or subtraction leaves no remainder, there is no second equation.
translations.idiomatic: If the sum is exactly 180° or subtraction leaves zero, there is no second equation.

sentences.zh: 若次引為初度，或適足半周，亦無二均數。

translations.literal: If the secondary argument is at the initial degree, or exactly fills a semicircle, there is also no second equation.
translations.idiomatic: There is also no second equation if the secondary argument is at 0° or exactly 180°.

sentences.zh: 求得對通弦之角為二均數，如無初均數，以次輪心距地心為一邊，次輪半徑為一邊；

translations.literal: Obtain the angle opposite the versed sine as the second equation; if there is no first equation, take the line from the secondary epicycle center to Earth's center as one side, the secondary epicycle radius as one side;
translations.idiomatic: The angle opposite the chord is the second equation; without a first equation, use the line to the secondary epicycle center and the secondary epicycle radius as the two sides;

sentences.zh: 次引倍數為所夾之角，次引過半周者，與全周相減，用其餘；

translations.literal: the doubled secondary argument as the contained angle; if the secondary argument passes a semicircle, subtract from the full circuit and use the remainder;
translations.idiomatic: take double the secondary argument as the included angle, reducing by 360° if it exceeds 180°;

sentences.zh: 在最高為所夾之內角，在最卑為所夾之外角，求得對次輪半徑之角為二均數。

translations.literal: at the highest point it is the interior contained angle, at the lowest the exterior contained angle; obtain the angle opposite the secondary epicycle radius as the second equation.
translations.idiomatic: use the interior angle at apogee and the exterior at perigee; the angle opposite the secondary epicycle radius is the second equation.

sentences.zh: 隨定其加減號。

translations.literal: Determine its sign of addition or subtraction accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Determine the sign of addition or subtraction accordingly.

sentences.zh: 以初均數與均輪心距最卑之度相加，為加減泛限。

translations.literal: Add the first equation to the degrees from the equating epicycle center to the lowest point as the general limit for addition and subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: Add the first equation to the arc from the equating epicycle center to perigee to obtain the general comparison limit.

sentences.zh: 泛限適足九十度，則二均加減與初均同。

translations.literal: If the general limit exactly fills ninety degrees, the second equation's addition or subtraction is the same as the first.
translations.idiomatic: If the general limit is exactly 90°, the second equation has the same sign as the first.

sentences.zh: 如泛限不足九十度，則與九十度相減，餘數倍之，為加減定限。

translations.literal: If the general limit is insufficient for ninety degrees, subtract it from ninety degrees, double the remainder as the fixed limit for addition and subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: If less than 90°, subtract from 90° and double the remainder for the fixed comparison limit.

sentences.zh: 初均減者，以次引倍度；

translations.literal: When the first equation subtracts, use the doubled secondary argument;
translations.idiomatic: If the first equation subtracts, compare the doubled secondary argument;

sentences.zh: 初均加者，以次引倍度減全周之餘數，皆與定限較。

translations.literal: when the first equation adds, use the remainder of the doubled secondary argument subtracted from the full circuit — all compare with the fixed limit.
translations.idiomatic: if the first equation adds, compare the remainder of double the secondary argument minus 360° against the fixed limit.

sentences.zh: 如泛限過九十度者，減去九十度，餘數倍之，為加減定限。

translations.literal: If the general limit passes ninety degrees, subtract ninety degrees, double the remainder as the fixed limit for addition and subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: If the general limit exceeds 90°, subtract 90° and double the remainder for the fixed limit.

sentences.zh: 初均加者，以次引倍度；

translations.literal: When the first equation adds, use the doubled secondary argument;
translations.idiomatic: If the first equation adds, compare the doubled secondary argument;

sentences.zh: 初均減者，以次引倍度減全周之餘數，皆與定限較。

translations.literal: when the first equation subtracts, use the remainder of the doubled secondary argument subtracted from the full circuit — all compare with the fixed limit.
translations.idiomatic: if the first equation subtracts, compare the remainder of double the secondary argument minus 360° against the fixed limit.

sentences.zh: 並以大於定限，則二均之加減與初均同；

translations.literal: In both cases if greater than the fixed limit, the second equation's addition or subtraction is the same as the first;
translations.idiomatic: If the value exceeds the fixed limit, the second equation matches the first in sign;

sentences.zh: 小於定限者反是。

translations.literal: if less than the fixed limit, the reverse.
translations.idiomatic: if less, the sign is reversed.

sentences.zh: ★求得對角之邊，為次均輪心距地心線。

translations.literal: Obtain the side opposite the angle — this is the line from the secondary equating epicycle center to Earth's center.
translations.idiomatic: The side opposite the angle is the line from Earth's center to the secondary equating epicycle center.

sentences.zh: 又以此線及次引，用平三角形，以次均輪心距地為一邊，次均輪半徑為一邊，次引倍度為所夾之角，次引過半周者，與全周相減，用其餘。

translations.literal: Again with this line and the secondary argument, use a plane triangle: take the line from the secondary equating epicycle center to Earth as one side, the secondary equating epicycle radius as one side, the doubled secondary argument as the contained angle; if the secondary argument passes a semicircle, subtract from the full circuit and use the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: With this line and the secondary argument, form a plane triangle using the line to the secondary equating epicycle center and its radius as sides and double the secondary argument as the included angle, reducing by 360° if needed.

sentences.zh: 求得對次均輪半徑之角為三均數，隨定其加減號。

translations.literal: Obtain the angle opposite the secondary equating epicycle radius as the third equation, and determine its sign of addition or subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: The angle opposite the secondary equating epicycle radius is the third equation; determine its sign accordingly.

sentences.zh: 次引倍度不及半周為加，過半周為減。

translations.literal: When the doubled secondary argument does not reach a semicircle, add; when it passes a semicircle, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add if double the secondary argument is under 180°, subtract if over.

sentences.zh: 乃以二均數與三均數相加減，為二三均數。

translations.literal: Then add or subtract the second and third equations to obtain the second-and-third equation.
translations.idiomatic: Combine the second and third equations to obtain the combined second-third correction.

sentences.zh: 兩均數同號則相加，異號則相減。

translations.literal: When the two equations share the same sign, add; when different signs, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If both equations share a sign, add them; if their signs differ, subtract.

sentences.zh: 以加減初實行，兩均數同為加者仍為加，同為減者仍為減。

translations.literal: Apply to add or subtract from the first true motion: when both equations are addition, the result remains addition; when both are subtraction, the result remains subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the result to the first true longitude: if both equations add, add; if both subtract, subtract.

sentences.zh: 一為加一為減者，加數大為加，減數大為減。

translations.literal: When one is addition and one subtraction, if the addition term is larger, add; if the subtraction term is larger, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If one equation adds and the other subtracts, take the sign of the larger term.

sentences.zh: 為白道實行。

translations.literal: This is the white-path true motion.
translations.idiomatic: This is the true lunar-path longitude.

sentences.zh: 求黃道實行，用弧三角形，以黃白大距中數為一邊，大距半較為一邊，次引倍度為所夾之角，次引過半周與全周相減，用其餘。

translations.literal: To find ecliptic true motion, use a spherical triangle: take the mean great yellow-white distance as one side, the half-difference of the distance as one side, the doubled secondary argument as the contained angle; if the secondary argument passes a semicircle, subtract from the full circuit and use the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: For true ecliptic longitude, solve a spherical triangle with the mean lunar latitude, the latitude half-difference, and double the secondary argument as the included angle, reducing by 360° if needed.

sentences.zh: 求得對角之邊為黃白大距，並求得對半較之角為交均。

translations.literal: Obtain the side opposite the angle as the great yellow-white distance, and also obtain the angle opposite the half-difference as the node equation.
translations.idiomatic: The side opposite the angle gives the lunar latitude; the angle opposite the half-difference is the node equation.

sentences.zh: 以交均加減正交平行，次引倍度不及半周為減，過半周為加。

translations.literal: Add or subtract the node equation from node mean motion: if the doubled secondary argument does not reach a semicircle, subtract; if it passes a semicircle, add.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the node equation to the node's mean longitude: subtract if double the secondary argument is under 180°, add if over.

sentences.zh: 得正交實行。

translations.literal: Obtain the node's true motion.
translations.idiomatic: This gives the true node longitude.

sentences.zh: 又加減六宮為中交實行，置白道實行，減正交實行，得距交實行。

translations.literal: Again add or subtract six mansions for the middle-node true motion; set the white-path true motion, subtract the node true motion, and obtain the arc from the node true motion.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract six mansions for the middle-node longitude; subtract the node longitude from the lunar-path true longitude to obtain the arc from the node.

sentences.zh: 以本天半徑為一率，黃白大距之餘弦為二率，距交實行之正切為三率，求得四率為黃道之正切。

translations.literal: Take primary heaven radius as first ratio, cosine of the great yellow-white distance as second ratio, tangent of the arc from the node true motion as third ratio; obtain the fourth ratio as the ecliptic tangent.
translations.idiomatic: Use the deferent radius as the first ratio, the cosine of lunar latitude as the second, and the tangent of the arc from the node as the third; the fourth ratio is the ecliptic tangent.

sentences.zh: 檢表得度分，與距交實行相減，餘為升度差，以加減白道實行，距交實行不過象限，或過二象限為減，過象限及過三象限為加。

translations.literal: Look up the table to obtain degrees and minutes, subtract from the arc from the node true motion; the remainder is the ascension difference. Add or subtract from the white-path true motion: if the arc from the node does not pass a quadrant, or passes two quadrants, subtract; if it passes a quadrant or three quadrants, add.
translations.idiomatic: Look up degrees and minutes in the table and subtract from the arc from the node to obtain the ascension difference, then apply it to the lunar-path longitude: subtract if the arc is within one or two quadrants of the node, add if within one or three.

sentences.zh: 為黃道實行。

translations.literal: This is the ecliptic true motion.
translations.idiomatic: This is the true ecliptic longitude.

sentences.zh: 求黃道緯度，以本天半徑為一率，黃白大距之正弦為二率，距交實行之正弦為三率，求得四率為正弦。

translations.literal: To find ecliptic latitude: take primary heaven radius as first ratio, sine of the great yellow-white distance as second ratio, sine of the arc from the node true motion as third ratio; obtain the fourth ratio as sine.
translations.idiomatic: For ecliptic latitude, use the deferent radius as the first ratio, the sine of lunar latitude as the second, and the sine of the arc from the node as the third; the fourth ratio is the sine.

sentences.zh: 檢表得黃道緯度，距交實行初宮至五宮為黃道北，六宮至十一宮為黃道南。

translations.literal: Look up the table to obtain ecliptic latitude; from the arc from the node at mansions 0 through 5 the ecliptic is north, from mansions 6 through 11 south.
translations.idiomatic: Look up the ecliptic latitude in the table; the latitude is north from mansions 0–5 of the arc from the node and south from mansions 6–11.

sentences.zh: 求四種宿度，依日躔求宿度法，求得本年黃道宿鈐。

translations.literal: To find the four kinds of lodge degree, follow the method for finding lodge degree from solar motion, and obtain this year's ecliptic lodge pivot.
translations.idiomatic: For the four lodge longitudes, use the solar-motion lodge method to obtain this year's ecliptic lodge pivot.

sentences.zh: 以黃道實行、月孛行及正交、中交實行各度分視其足減宿鈐內某宿則減之，餘為四種宿度。

translations.literal: For the ecliptic true motion, lunar apogee motion, and node and middle-node true motions, each in degrees and minutes, see whether it suffices to subtract a lodge within the lodge pivot; if so subtract it — the remainder is the four kinds of lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: For each of the ecliptic, apogee, node, and middle-node longitudes, subtract the appropriate lodge from the pivot wherever possible; the remainders are the four lodge positions.

sentences.zh: 求紀日值宿，同日躔。

translations.literal: To find the sexagenary day's lodge assignment, same as solar motion.
translations.idiomatic: For the lodge of the sexagenary day, use the same method as for solar motion.

sentences.zh: 求交宮時刻，以太陰本日實行與次日實行相減未過宮為本日，已過宮為次日。

translations.literal: To find the moment of node mansion crossing: subtract this day's moon true motion from the next day's; if the mansion has not been passed, it belongs to this day; if already passed, to the next day.
translations.idiomatic: For the time the moon crosses a node mansion, compare today's and tomorrow's true longitudes: if the crossing has not yet occurred, use today; if it has, use tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 餘為一率，刻下分為二率，太陰本日實行不用宮。

translations.literal: The remainder is the first ratio, the minutes below the quarter the second ratio; use this day's moon true motion without the mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Take the remainder as the first ratio and the fractional minutes as the second; use today's true longitude without its mansion.

sentences.zh: 與三十度相減餘為三率，求得四率為距子正分數。

translations.literal: Subtract from thirty degrees for the third ratio; obtain the fourth ratio as the fraction from midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 30° for the third ratio; the fourth ratio is the time from midnight.

sentences.zh: 如法收之，得交宮時刻。

translations.literal: Collect by the method to obtain the moment of node mansion crossing.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce by the standard method to obtain the node-crossing time.

sentences.zh: 求太陰出入時刻，以本日太陽黃道經度求其相當赤道經度。

translations.literal: To find the moon's rising and setting moments: from this day's solar ecliptic longitude find the corresponding equatorial longitude.
translations.idiomatic: For moonrise and moonset, convert the sun's ecliptic longitude for the day to the corresponding equatorial longitude.

sentences.zh: 又用弧三角形，以太陰距黃極為一邊，黃極距北極為一邊，即黃赤大距。

translations.literal: Again use a spherical triangle: take the moon's distance from the ecliptic pole as one side, the ecliptic pole's distance from the north pole as one side — that is, the great yellow-red distance.
translations.idiomatic: Next solve a spherical triangle with the moon's distance from the ecliptic pole and the obliquity as sides.

sentences.zh: 太陰距冬至黃道經度為所夾之外角，過半周者與全周相減，用其餘。

translations.literal: The moon's ecliptic longitude from winter solstice is the exterior contained angle; if it passes a semicircle, subtract from the full circuit and use the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Take the moon's ecliptic longitude from the winter solstice as the exterior angle, reducing by 360° if it exceeds 180°.

sentences.zh: 求得對邊為太陰距北極度。

translations.literal: Obtain the opposite side as the moon's distance from the north pole in degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The opposite side gives the moon's polar distance.

sentences.zh: 與九十度相減，得赤道緯度。

translations.literal: Subtract from ninety degrees to obtain equatorial latitude.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 90° to obtain equatorial declination.

sentences.zh: 不及九十度者，與九十度相減，餘為北緯。

translations.literal: If it does not reach ninety degrees, subtract from ninety degrees; the remainder is north latitude.
translations.idiomatic: If under 90°, subtract from 90°; the remainder is north declination.

sentences.zh: 過九十度者，減去九十度，餘為南緯。

translations.literal: If it passes ninety degrees, subtract ninety degrees; the remainder is south latitude.
translations.idiomatic: If over 90°, subtract 90°; the remainder is south declination.

sentences.zh: 又求得近北極之角，為太陰距冬至赤道經度。

translations.literal: Again obtain the angle nearer the north pole as the moon's equatorial longitude from winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: The angle at the north pole gives the moon's equatorial longitude from the winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 乃以本天半徑為一率，北極高度之正切為二率，太陰赤道緯度之正切為三率，求得四率為正弦。

translations.literal: Then take primary heaven radius as first ratio, tangent of north polar altitude as second ratio, tangent of the moon's equatorial latitude as third ratio; obtain the fourth ratio as sine.
translations.idiomatic: Use the deferent radius as the first ratio, the tangent of the observer's latitude as the second, and the tangent of the moon's declination as the third; the fourth ratio is the sine.

sentences.zh: 檢表得太陰出入在卯酉前後赤道度，太陰在赤道北，出在卯正前，入在酉正後；

translations.literal: Look up the table to obtain the moon's rising and setting equatorial degrees before and after Mao and You; when the moon is north of the equator, it rises before exact Mao and sets after exact You;
translations.idiomatic: Look up the equatorial degrees before and after Mao and You for moonrise and moonset; north of the equator, the moon rises before Mao and sets after You;

sentences.zh: 太陰在赤道南，出在卯正後，入在酉正前。

translations.literal: when the moon is south of the equator, it rises after exact Mao and sets before exact You.
translations.idiomatic: south of the equator, it rises after Mao and sets before You.

sentences.zh: 以加減前減後加。

translations.literal: Add or subtract: subtract before, add after.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the correction: subtract before the cardinal point, add after.

sentences.zh: 太陰距太陽赤道度，太陰赤道經度內減去太陽赤道經度即得。

translations.literal: The moon's equatorial distance from the sun: subtract the sun's equatorial longitude from within the moon's equatorial longitude to obtain it.
translations.idiomatic: The moon's elongation in equatorial longitude is the moon's equatorial longitude minus the sun's.

sentences.zh: 得數變時。

translations.literal: Convert the number to time.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the result to time.

sentences.zh: 自卯正酉正後計之，出地自卯正後，入地自酉正後。

translations.literal: Count from after exact Mao and exact You: for rising, from after exact Mao; for setting, from after exact You.
translations.idiomatic: Measure from after Mao for rising and from after You for setting.

sentences.zh: 得何時刻，再加本時太陰行度之時刻，約一小時行三十分，變為時之二分。

translations.literal: Obtain the moment, then add the time corresponding to this hour's moon motion — roughly thirty minutes of motion per hour, converted to two parts of an hour.
translations.idiomatic: Find the base time, then add the time for the moon's motion in the current hour — about 30′ of motion per hour, converted to two fractional hours.

sentences.zh: 即得太陰出入時刻。

translations.literal: Thus obtain the moon's rising and setting moments.
translations.idiomatic: This gives moonrise and moonset.

sentences.zh: 求合朔弦望，太陰實行與太陽實行同宮同度為合朔限，距三宮為上弦限，距六宮為望限，距九宮為下弦限，皆以太陰未及限度為本日，已過限度為次日。

translations.literal: To find new moon, quarters, and full moon: when moon and sun true motions share the same mansion and degree, that is the new-moon limit; three mansions apart is the first-quarter limit, six the full-moon limit, nine the last-quarter limit — in each case, if the moon has not yet reached the limit, use this day; if already passed, use the next day.
translations.idiomatic: For new moon and the quarters and full moon: conjunction is when the moon and sun share mansion and degree; limits fall three, six, and nine mansions apart for first quarter, full moon, and last quarter — use today if the moon has not reached the limit, tomorrow if it has.

sentences.zh: 乃以太陰、太陽本日實行與次日實行各相減，兩減餘數相較為一率，刻下分為二率，本日太陽實行加限度上弦加三宮，望加六宮，下弦加九宮。

translations.literal: Then subtract this day's and the next day's moon and sun true motions pairwise; compare the two remainders as first ratio, the minutes below the quarter as second ratio; add the limit to this day's solar true motion — three mansions for first quarter, six for full moon, nine for last quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract today's and tomorrow's true longitudes for moon and sun; take the ratio of the remainders as the first ratio and the fractional minutes as the second; add the limit to today's solar longitude — three mansions for first quarter, six for full moon, nine for last quarter.

sentences.zh: 減本日太陰實行，餘為三率，求得四率為距子正之分。

translations.literal: Subtract this day's moon true motion; the remainder is the third ratio; obtain the fourth ratio as the fraction from midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract today's lunar longitude for the third ratio; the fourth ratio is the time from midnight.

sentences.zh: 如法收之，得合朔弦望時刻。

translations.literal: Collect by the method to obtain the moments of new moon, quarters, and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce by the standard method to obtain the times of new moon and the quarters and full moon.

sentences.zh: 求正升斜升橫升，合朔日，太陰實行自子宮十五度至酉宮十五度為正升，自酉宮十五度至未宮初度為斜升，自未宮初度至寅宮十五度為橫升，自寅宮十五度至子宮十五度為斜升。

translations.literal: To find direct, oblique, and horizontal ascension: on a new-moon day, when the moon's true motion runs from mansion Zi 15° to mansion You 15°, it is direct ascension; from You 15° to Wei at 0° oblique ascension; from Wei 0° to Yin 15° horizontal ascension; from Yin 15° to Zi 15° oblique ascension.
translations.idiomatic: For direct, oblique, and horizontal ascension on new-moon day: direct from Zi 15° to You 15°, oblique from You 15° to Wei 0°, horizontal from Wei 0° to Yin 15°, oblique from Yin 15° back to Zi 15°.

sentences.zh: 求月大小，以前朔後朔相較，日干同者前月大，不同者前月小。
